name: Real Eroge Situation! Hx3
original_name: リアルエロゲシチュエーション！Ｈ×３
source:
This is the fandisc for Real Eroge Situation. Shinobu was confessed to by Ayame, Kanna and Yuri, then was subject to their non-stop sexual advances. He had planned to choose one of them before the school festival, but he was ultimately unable to do so.

“Ehehe, it’s been a while, onii-chan♪”

One day, his childhood friend Ui returned after moving away when they were still kids. Her parents were originally supposed to accompany her, but they had urgent matters to attend to. Nazuna suggested that Ui stay at Shinobu’s home in the meantime.

“I’m being serious. I’ve always always loved you, onii-chan.
So… have sex with me♪”

She was extremely direct with her feelings for him which had built up over the years they’ve been apart. This was the trigger for the other girls to make even more extreme sexual advances towards him! Surrounded by four girls who are infatuated with him, this is truly a harem situation!

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2018/01/01/january-2018-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
这是《真实色情情境》的粉丝碟。忍被菖蒲、加奈与由里告白后，遭到她们不停的性攻势。他本想在校庆前选择其中一人，却最终没能做出决定。

“诶嘿嘿，好久不见，哥哥♪”

一天，儿时搬走的青梅竹马宇衣回来了。她的父母原本要陪她同行，却因急事无法前来。薙菜提议让宇衣暂时住在忍家。

“我是认真的。我一直一直喜欢你，哥哥。
所以……和我做爱吧♪”

她直白地表达了分别多年积累的感情。这成为其他女孩对忍发动更极端性攻势的导火索！被4名迷恋自己的女孩包围，这才是真正的后宫情境！
